nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a real Banach space with its Borel σ-algebra, let $K \subseteq X$ be compact and convex, and let $x$ be an extreme point of $K$. If $\mu$ is a probability measure on $X$ with $\mu(X \setminus K) = 0$ whose barycenter $\int y \, d\mu(y)$ (a Bochner integral) equals $x$, then $\mu$ is the Dirac measure at $x$.
nodes.title: Bauer's uniqueness theorem at extreme points

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a second-countable real Banach space with its Borel σ-algebra and let $K \subseteq E$ be compact. For every $x \in K$ there is a probability measure $\mu$ on $E$ such that the set $\operatorname{ext} K$ of extreme points of $K$ has $\mu(\operatorname{ext} K) = 1$, the identity map $y \mapsto y$ is Bochner integrable for $\mu$, and $\int_E y \, d\mu(y) = x$.
nodes.title: Choquet representation for compact sets

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a second-countable real Banach space with its Borel σ-algebra and let $K \subseteq E$ be a nonempty compact convex set. For every $x \in K$ there is a probability measure $\mu$ on $E$ such that the set $\operatorname{ext} K$ of extreme points of $K$ has $\mu(\operatorname{ext} K) = 1$, the identity map $y \mapsto y$ is Bochner integrable for $\mu$, and $\int_E y \, d\mu(y) = x$.
nodes.title: Choquet's theorem

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a real Banach space with its Borel σ-algebra and let $K \subseteq X$ be compact and convex. For every $x \in K$ there is a probability measure $\mu$ on $X$ such that the complement of the set of extreme points of $K$ has $\mu$-measure $0$ and the barycenter $\int y \, d\mu(y)$ (a Bochner integral) equals $x$.
nodes.title: Choquet's representation theorem in Banach spaces
